subject: Delivery window change due to rail closure
text: We need to reschedule tomorrow morning's crate delivery because the planned route through the east side is blocked after a rail closure and several side streets are cut off. Our van is not available until afternoon, and two staff members are stranded on the northbound line, so early handling will be slow. Please move the drop-off to between three and five p.m. if your warehouse crew can still accept pallets then. The consignment has twelve marked boxes and one fragile instrument case, so someone should remain available to inspect it rather than leave it on the dock. If the driver has already started the original route, ask him to call the number on the invoice and wait for instructions before continuing. I am also arranging a smaller courier for the replacement clamps if the main shipment cannot move. Sorry for the last-minute notice; the disruption only became clear during the commute. Confirm by reply whether the later slot works, and if you need a revised access list, I will forward it immediately so nothing sits outside overnight.
